metadata.name: held_quote
metadata.description: Price holds for binary outcome shares: buy now or hold an executable price, settled atomically on Solana

accounts.name: vault
docs: Collateral backing every outstanding set.

accounts.name: proceeds_vault
docs: Where buyers' payments and hold fees land. Owned by the pool PDA so the
maker can't close or swap it to block exercises; they claim from it instead.

accounts.name: winning_mint
docs: Must be the winning side's mint.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone. Pays only the transaction fee; receives nothing.

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.msg: Price must be between $0.01 and $0.99, in whole cents

errors.name: InvalidQuantity
errors.msg: Quantity must be at least 1 share

errors.name: InvalidHoldLength
errors.msg: Hold length must be between 1 second and the pool's maximum

errors.name: PriceAboveLimit
errors.msg: The price is now above your maximum

errors.name: FeeAboveLimit
errors.msg: The hold fee is now above your maximum

errors.name: InsufficientInventory
errors.msg: Not enough shares available

errors.name: HoldExpired
errors.msg: This hold has expired

errors.name: HoldNotExpired
errors.msg: This hold hasn't expired yet

errors.name: HoldNotActive
errors.msg: This hold was already exercised or released

errors.name: MarketClosed
errors.msg: Trading is closed for this market

errors.name: HoldPastClose
errors.msg: The hold would outlast the market's trading window

errors.name: MarketResolved
errors.msg: This market is already resolved

errors.name: MarketNotResolved
errors.msg: This market isn't resolved yet

errors.name: InvalidOutcome
errors.msg: Outcome must be 1 (YES) or 2 (NO)

errors.name: SelfTrade
errors.msg: Makers can't buy from their own pool

errors.name: WithdrawExceedsAvailable
errors.msg: Can't withdraw shares that are reserved by holds

errors.name: CloseTimeInPast
errors.msg: Close time must be in the future

errors.name: TextTooLong
errors.msg: Text is too long

errors.name: WrongTokenAccount
errors.msg: Token account doesn't match this market or pool

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

types.name: Filled
docs: kind: 0 = immediate (buy_now), 1 = exercised hold.

fields.name: hold
docs: Default pubkey for immediate buys.

types.name: Hold
docs: A held price: `qty` shares reserved for `buyer` at `price` until `expires_at`.
seeds = ["hold", pool, buyer, nonce_le]
Never closed: after settlement it stays on-chain as the receipt.

fields.name: buyer
docs: The only wallet that can exercise.

fields.name: outcome_mint
docs: What changes hands on exercise.

fields.name: side
docs: 0 = buy YES (the only side in this version).

fields.name: price
docs: Held price, base units per share.

fields.name: fee_paid
docs: Fee paid to the maker when the hold was written (non-refundable).

fields.name: terms_seq
docs: Pool terms_seq at the moment of the hold.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Exercise allowed while now < expires_at; release allowed when now >= expires_at.

fields.name: caller
docs: Whoever sent the cleanup transaction (anyone may).

fields.name: delta
docs: Positive = deposit, negative = withdraw.

types.name: Market
docs: A binary question with fully collateralized YES/NO share mints.
seeds = ["market", id_le]

fields.name: admin
docs: Creates the market and resolves it (test admin on devnet).

fields.name: yes_mint
docs: PDA mints (authority = this market), 0 decimals.

fields.name: vault
docs: Collateral backing every outstanding set (ATA owned by this market).

fields.name: resolution_source
docs: Where the answer comes from, in words (shown to buyers).

fields.name: reference
docs: Display-only reference contract this market mirrors (e.g. a Gemini symbol).
Prices from it are never executable here.

fields.name: close_time
docs: Trading (buy_now / hold / exercise) stops at this unix time.

fields.name: outcome
docs: 0 = unresolved, 1 = YES won, 2 = NO won.

fields.name: sets_outstanding
docs: Complete sets minted minus sets redeemed (each backed by SHARE_UNIT in the vault).

types.name: Pool
docs: One maker's YES inventory for one market, held in program custody.
seeds = ["pool", market, maker]
Invariant (checked in tests): yes_vault balance == available + reserved.

fields.name: yes_vault
docs: YES shares in custody (ATA owned by this pool PDA).

fields.name: proceeds_vault
docs: Collateral account owned by this pool PDA; every payment and hold fee lands here.
(Not the maker's own account: a maker could close that to make exercises fail.)

fields.name: ask
docs: Executable ask for immediate buys and new holds (base units per share).

fields.name: hold_rate
docs: Hold fee in base units per share per minute (pro-rated per second, rounded up).

fields.name: max_hold_secs
docs: Longest hold this maker will write.

fields.name: available
docs: Shares anyone can buy or hold right now.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Shares locked by active holds (can only go to the hold's buyer, or back to `available`).

fields.name: terms_seq
docs: Bumps every time the maker changes terms; holds record the seq they were written at.

types.name: PoolTerms
docs: Terms a maker sets on their pool.
